subject: Chapter opening maps and closing storylines (chNN-map, chNN-story), 44 generated figures
process: Content authored per chapter by four agents into docs/.vuepress/reader/chapters/chNN.json; SVGs generated by bin/chapter_figures.py; traditional variants by tools/localize.py.

Independent review by four fresh agents that had not authored the figures, one batch each, against docs/chNN.md, the glossary and the reader-visualization rules (opening map = pre-reading map in everyday words, about 100 characters; closing storyline = 3 to 6 acts plus the chapter's claim; fidelity of conditions, negation, quantifiers, modality, actors, term senses).

Main agent read all four reports, accepted every proposed fix, ruled two conflicts (ch14 map drops its fourth pillar; ch15 map footer removed, the 5% accounting with its premise stays in the storyline), and assigned four editing agents that had not reviewed the same chapters.

Editors applied the fixes and shortened every opening map toward the 100-character guideline; the generator was extended to measure traditional-Chinese widths with a 3% margin, to carry reviewer boundary notes in a metadata `limits` field, and to give the axes mobile layout its own region icon and heading.
Main agent verified fix application programmatically, regenerated and localized all assets, ran the static and content checks, the real-browser geometry pass and a visual sample.

rulings: ch14-map: remove the fourth pillar (naming difficulty as a design red flag); the storyline keeps it.
ch15-map: delete the footer instead of choosing between the two competing rewrites; the storyline's fourth act carries the 5% estimate with its premise.
ch20-map / ch04-map mobile axes: fixed in the generator (region row uses its own icon, items follow under a heading), not in chapter data.
Opening maps were additionally shortened to about 120 to 160 Chinese characters because every map exceeded the pre-reading guideline; details removed from maps were not moved into storylines.

application.note: Adapted cases were checked one by one: the hedges (通常、可能、约、尽量、理想情况下) and factual corrections are present; several proposed footers were removed under the length rule rather than shortened.

verification.generatorBudgetCheck: uv run --with opencc==1.4.1 python3 bin/chapter_figures.py --check: up to date, 22 chapters, traditional widths included
verification.staticChecks: tools/verify.py --complete: 94 teaching diagrams, 388 SVG assets, 60 Python examples
verification.visualSample: Desktop maps for ch01, ch02, ch05, ch06, ch07, ch10, ch11, ch13, ch15, ch17, ch19 and mobile ch20/ch21 plus storylines ch06, ch12, ch13 viewed after regeneration.
verification.banned-patterns: no dashes as punctuation, no forced-contrast constructions in chapter data

limitations: Explanatory-design judgment by agents; no real-reader comprehension test.
Reviewers and editors are model agents with separated contexts, not professional human editors.
Character-width estimation is approximate; the browser geometry pass covers the installed macOS Chrome fonts only.
